categories.name: safety
categories.title: Safety & TigerStyle
categories.description: Mission-critical EVM safety invariants from CLAUDE.md and TigerStyle across Zig and Rust FFI code.

metrics.name: zig-no-panic
metrics.title: Zig no panic
metrics.description: Never use @panic or unreachable in production src/**/*.zig, validate inputs and return typed errors instead.

metrics.name: zig-no-forbidden-debug
metrics.title: Zig no forbidden debug
metrics.description: Never use std.debug.assert or std.debug.print in production src/**/*.zig, use tracer.assert() and log.zig.

metrics.name: zig-no-swallowed-errors
metrics.title: Zig no swallowed errors
metrics.description: Never swallow errors with empty catch or return error.NotImplemented stubs in production src/**/*.zig.

metrics.name: zig-assertion-density
metrics.title: Zig assertion density
metrics.description: Add tracer.assert() invariant checks to production EVM functions to raise assertion density toward TigerStyle levels.

metrics.name: rust-no-unwrap
metrics.title: Rust no unwrap
metrics.description: Replace .unwrap() and .expect() in Rust FFI crates (lib/ark, lib/foundry-compilers) with Result propagation.

metrics.name: rust-unsafe-blocks
metrics.title: Rust unsafe blocks
metrics.description: Minimize and encapsulate unsafe FFI blocks in lib/ark and lib/foundry-compilers behind safe wrappers.

categories.name: style
categories.title: Style & Limits
categories.description: TigerStyle structural bounds (70-line functions, 120-char lines) and canonical Zig formatting.

metrics.name: zig-fmt
metrics.title: Zig fmt
metrics.description: Keep all Zig files in src/ formatted with `zig fmt`.

metrics.name: function-length
metrics.title: Function length
metrics.description: Keep every production Zig runtime function at or below 70 lines (TigerStyle limit), decompose large handlers.

metrics.name: line-length
metrics.title: Line length
metrics.description: Keep production Zig lines at or below 120 characters (TigerStyle limit).

metrics.name: no-todo-markers
metrics.title: No todo markers
metrics.description: Resolve TODO, FIXME, XXX, and HACK markers in production src/**/*.zig instead of deferring work.

categories.name: footprint
categories.title: Footprint & Modularity
categories.description: Source file and subsystem modularity limits to keep the EVM auditable.

metrics.name: file-lines
metrics.title: File lines
metrics.description: Keep production Zig files focused and under 500 lines, split monolithic modules like src/evm.zig.

metrics.name: subsystem-size
metrics.title: Subsystem size
metrics.description: Keep each src/ subsystem compact and modular, split sprawling subsystems into cohesive packages.

categories.name: verification
categories.title: Verification & Tests
categories.description: Formal verification proofs (Lean 4 & SMT-LIB2) and inline Zig unit test coverage.

metrics.name: lean-no-sorry
metrics.title: Lean no sorry
metrics.description: Never commit `sorry` or unproved `axiom` declarations in verify/lean/**/*.lean, close every formal proof.

metrics.name: lean-theorems
metrics.title: Lean theorems
metrics.description: Expand Lean 4 theorem and lemma coverage in verify/lean/ for EVM opcodes, gas rules, and fusion passes.

metrics.name: smt-proofs
metrics.title: Smt proofs
metrics.description: Add SMT-LIB2 equivalence and overflow-safety proofs in verify/smt/proofs/ for arithmetic and fusion optimizations.

metrics.name: inline-test-coverage
metrics.title: Inline test coverage
metrics.description: Add inline `test` blocks inside production src/**/*.zig files (CLAUDE.md requires tests in source files).

categories.name: documentation
categories.title: Documentation
categories.description: Documentation link integrity and subsystem README coverage.

metrics.name: broken-links
metrics.title: Broken links
metrics.description: Fix broken relative and root-relative links in root Markdown files and docs/**/*.md.

metrics.name: subdir-readme
metrics.title: Subdir readme
metrics.description: Maintain a concise README.md in every production subsystem directory under src/.

categories.name: factory
categories.title: Factory & Trust
categories.description: Smithers Cloud factory projection, shared object-store trust boundaries, wiki freshness, release parity, and playground CSP integrity.

metrics.name: factory-projection
metrics.title: Factory projection
metrics.description: Keep .smithers/factory.json and .smithers/home.json schema-valid with docs URL, person-only merge policy, and maintainer, contributor, and viewer sections.

metrics.name: remote-cache-trust
metrics.title: Remote cache trust
metrics.description: Wire build.smithers.sh with split read and write secrets and never expose SMITHERS_CACHE_WRITE_TOKEN to pull_request jobs.

metrics.name: wiki-freshness
metrics.title: Wiki freshness
metrics.description: Keep every .smithers/wiki/*.md page frontmatter-valid with zero broken wikilinks, zero secret leaks, and a fresh docs/public/wiki.html build.

metrics.name: release-alignment
metrics.title: Release alignment
metrics.description: Keep build.zig.zon, sdks/typescript/package.json, CHANGELOG.md, and .github/workflows/release.yml aligned for automated main-branch releases and docs deploys.

metrics.name: workflow-security
metrics.title: Workflow security
metrics.description: Keep .smithers/workflows QuickJS-safe, .smithers/flows frontmatter-valid, and .smithers/playground CSP SHA-256 hashes exact.
